description: ts-optimize: resume pointer, command guard, commit guard, fast typecheck after edit batches, plugin-subagent guard, audit-surface pre-approval. Silent unless a run is open, a guarded command is typed, a plugin subagent acts, or the model runs a ts-opt audit command.

hooks.command: command -v node >/dev/null || exit 0; d=$PWD; while :; do [ -f "$d/.ts-optimize/state/open-run" ] && break; [ -e "$d/.git" ] && exit 0; n=$(dirname "$d"); [ "$n" = "$d" ] && exit 0; d=$n; done; exec node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/lib/hooks/session-start.mjs"

command -v node >/dev/null || exit 0; d=$PWD; while :; do [ -f "$d/.ts-optimize/state/open-run" ] && break; [ -e "$d/.git" ] && exit 0; n=$(dirname "$d"); [ "$n" = "$d" ] && exit 0; d=$n; done; exec node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/lib/hooks/commit-guard.mjs"

command -v node >/dev/null || exit 0; i=$(cat); case "$i" in *agent_type*ts-triager*|*agent_type*ts-architect*) printf '%s' "$i" | node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/lib/hooks/agent-guard.mjs";; esac; exit 0

command -v node >/dev/null || exit 0; d=$PWD; while :; do [ -f "$d/.ts-optimize/state/open-run" ] && break; [ -e "$d/.git" ] && exit 0; n=$(dirname "$d"); [ "$n" = "$d" ] && exit 0; d=$n; done; exec node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/lib/hooks/fast-check.mjs"
